title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 74 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 74)

content.overview: Former section 74 — Status and effect of settlement agreement belonged to the detailed conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. That detailed regime was superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical and transition reference and must not be presented as current general conciliation law.

content.study:
Historical section 74 — Status and effect of settlement agreement

Former section 74 — Status and effect of settlement agreement belonged to the detailed conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. That detailed regime was superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical and transition reference and must not be presented as current general conciliation law.

Current-law rule: use the Mediation Act, 2023 for current mediation. Section 62 preserves qualifying conciliation proceedings initiated under the former sections 61 to 81 before commencement of the Mediation Act, 2023.

sections.heading: Current-law treatment
sections.body: Do not cite this former provision as the current general procedural source. Apply the Mediation Act, 2023, subject to section 62's saving.
